note: D2 slice 2 capability matrix. Each cell names the right a party needs and the check in capability_reference.py that exercises it. 'grant' rows apply only when delegated views are enabled (off by default, open question 4).

cells.needs: write on the source's area, authorship of the source, and read on the target at create time
for a collection, read on the container; members the embedder cannot read are not pinned
read on the source's area; without it the embed link is never reached
read on the object shown (the live head, or the pinned object)
read on the container; each member needs its own read and an unreadable member is neither shown nor counted
nothing from the embedder: the embedder losing read later changes no viewer's slot
embeds inside a shown object render by the viewer's own rights, one level at a time
removing a viewer from the target's area turns the slot unavailable on the next render
manage on the target's area at issue time
a grant names one embed link and exactly its pin; live embeds take no grant
read on the source's area and a grant inside its window; the slot shows the grant's id
revocation is non-renewal: a window of at most max_window_days, after which the slot is unavailable

attacks.attack: Embed a private document into a public post and show it to an outsider.
attacks.outcome: unavailable, with no mode, scope or title

attacks.attack: Embedder writes a grant for a target area it does not manage.
Grant on a live embed, so it covers whatever the head becomes.
Grant covers more than the pin (another object, or a different member set).
Reuse a grant on a second embed of the same object.
Keep showing after the window ends, or issue a window longer than the cap.
attacks.outcome: unavailable after not_after; an over-long window is refused

attacks.attack: Use the grant to read the target outside the embed (open it directly).
attacks.outcome: refused; the grant only fills its slot

attacks.attack: Reach a second private object through an embed inside the granted one.
Grow a granted collection after the grant to slip new members in.
attacks.outcome: only pinned members show; later members need the viewer's own read

attacks.attack: Turn delegated views on for one host only.
attacks.outcome: with the switch off, every grant is ignored and A1 holds
